legend_check: The map's own legend defines an explicit 'Under Construction' marker, visually distinct from ordinary station points. Directly inspecting the rendered map, this marker is attached only to Bedok South and Sungei Bedok (both Thomson-East Coast Line Stage 5, both absent from the 613-record S005 snapshot). No other station on the map carries this marker.
extraction_method: The 185 base station names below were read from the PDF's embedded text layer (not OCR) via direct multimodal inspection of the rendered map, then cross-checked programmatically against all 188 station_complexes.station_base_name values from the 2026-09-13 node run. This is a manually curated, versioned derived registry, not a deterministic automated parse: the PDF stores station-code labels and station-name labels as separate text objects not in single spatially-ordered rows, so name-to-station identity was confirmed visually, not by string-adjacency.
self_check_performed: An initial transcription pass produced 186/188 matches, incorrectly running two adjacent map labels ('Chinese Garden' and 'Clementi') together and dropping 'Clementi'. Re-inspecting the rendered map corrected this before finalising the roster below, raising matches to 187/188. This correction is disclosed as evidence of the extraction's known failure mode (adjacent labels merging), not hidden.
coverage_result: 187 of 188 station_complexes.station_base_name values from the 2026-09-13 run match a name in this roster. The sole non-match is Marina South, which is correctly absent from the current map and is separately classified not_operational via a known_exceptions entry.
limitation: This roster is scoped to the 613-exit S005 snapshot already in the pipeline; it does not assert coverage of every station on the wider network, and it must not be used to add a station absent from S005. A future station opening after this map's version date requires its own dated station-specific evidence, not this roster.
